list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four trilacunary tungstoantimonate Keggin fragments (two β-B-SbW9O33 and two α-A-SbW9O33) wrap a La6W12Co2 core to form a parallelogram-shaped tetrameric cluster; peripheral Na+ ions link the polyanions into a 2D framework.

synthesis.procedure: The article describes subsequent addition of LaCl3·7H2O and CoCl2·6H2O to an in-situ-formed [SbW9O33]9− solution, but does not provide a numerical reagent amount in the main text.

reagents.amount: 200 µL (0.2 mmol) of prepared 1.0 mol/L aqueous solution
reagents.name: antimony(III) chloride

reagents.amount: 2.915 g (0.01 mol), for preparation of SbCl3 solution
reagents.name: diantimony trioxide

reagents.amount: 10.0 mL (36–38%), for preparation of SbCl3 solution
reagents.name: hydrochloric acid

synthesis.time: 5 min stirring, then 3 min stirring, then 2 h heating; crystals obtained within approximately one day
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Aqueous solution synthesis; ambient evaporation in a beaker
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool to room temperature and filter; evaporate the filtrate in a beaker under ambient conditions to obtain crystals within approximately one day.

synthesis.procedure: The article describes subsequent addition of LaCl3·7H2O and MnCl2·4H2O to an in-situ-formed [SbW9O33]9− solution, but does not provide a numerical reagent amount in the main text.
